name: systems-map
description: Ariadne Maps — a single-page web app for building and simulating causal maps from a spreadsheet.

scripts.build: vite build && node scripts/rename-dist.mjs && node scripts/check-brand.mjs
scripts.build:white-label: vite build --mode whitelabel && node scripts/rename-dist.mjs dist-white-label && node scripts/check-brand.mjs --absent --dir=dist-white-label
scripts.build:all: npm run build && npm run build:hosted
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run lint && npm run build:all && npm run check:performance
